emma_cs: Heads up — BluePeak onboarding is hitting a sudden spike of 429s on preflight requests during warmup. Started ~09:12 PST. They reported mobile SDK calls failing intermittently.

lucy_dev: Which SDK version are they on? 1.4.x or older?

emma_cs: They upgraded to 1.4.0 last week (both web + mobile). Logs show repeated POST /v1/preflight -> 429 throttle-window, lots of distinct client IDs but same IP block.

raju_infra: Do we know how they mint ephemeral tokens? Are they requesting new ephemeral for every UI instance?

emma_cs: Looks like per-device/per-tab ephemeral renewal. TTL is set to 10s on their integration. Snippet from their request headers below: 

emma_cs: ```
POST /v1/preflight HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJ...
X-Client-Id: bluepeak-mobile-42
Content-Type: application/json
```

oliver_sre: Oof — short TTL + per-tab/device minting = stampede. If each client requests a new ephemeral token frequently, preflight rps will spike. Two quick mitigations: increase token TTL (e.g., 60s) and enable client-side reuse / splay jitter. Also ensure HTTP/2 connection reuse so preflight doesn't fan out.

lucy_dev: For the mobile SDK we added a "preferEphemeralReuse" flag in 1.4.1 — it causes the SDK to reuse the last ephemeral token for N seconds before requesting a new one. Could ask them to enable that. Also our preflight cache key treats Authorization as significant, so different tokens bypass cache.

emma_cs: I'll ask them to flip the reuse flag and temporarily raise TTL. Can we also bump their quota while they validate? They're hitting ~1k preflight/min at peak.

raju_infra: I can do a short-term quota bump. Planning to increase their preflight allowance by 3x for 30 minutes. deploy-bot: schedule the change.

deploy-bot: Scheduled quota adjustment: customer=bluepeak factor=3 expires=1729990335 (requested by raju_infra) :white_check_mark:

emma_cs: Customer turned on preferEphemeralReuse and bumped TTL to 60s. After the quota bump, 429s dropped dramatically (from ~200/min to ~2/min). They're continuing ramp.

oliver_sre: Great. Follow-up items: 1) Add short one-pager for onboarding best practices around ephemeral tokens + preflight splay; 2) Consider improving docs/examples to show token reuse patterns for mobile clients. @lucy_dev can you draft the doc?

lucy_dev: Yep — I'll draft a short page and include an SDK example with the flag and a recommended TTL table.

emma_cs: Closing this thread for now — root cause summary: ephemeral token per-device + short TTL caused preflight stampede. Mitigations applied: client-side reuse flag, TTL increased, temporary quota bump. Will re-open if anything recurs. :thumbsup:

oliver_sre: Nice triage. Suggest we also add a monitoring alert for repeated preflight 429 spikes per-customer so CS can auto-escalate earlier.

emma_cs: Agreed — I'll file a small ticket and loop in monitoring.

(END)
